Questions

Ask Us Your Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers about ordering and booking at Sethjee.

How can I reserve a table?

Call 0332 7384533 or send a WhatsApp message with your date, time and number of guests.

Where can I see the prices?

The full menu with prices in rupees is in the Order section above. Prices may change, so please confirm when you order.

Do you serve breakfast?

Yes. We serve a Desi Platter, an English Platter and à la carte items such as puri, halwa and omelettes.

Are there dishes for the whole family?

Yes. Soups come in family size and the Sethjee Special Platter serves four.
